## Research projects

- [Computational model of aesthetics](computational-aesthetics.qmd) — attention as a learned policy, perceptual compression, and learning progress as aesthetic reward. Includes the current model, candidate modeling approaches, open questions, and source links.

The research content has been copied from Notion for this wiki trial. The Notion site remains available; the two copies are not automatically synchronized.
